data.rule_text:
title: Detect Domain Account Enumeration via Net, dscl, ldapsearch, AdFind, ADRecon
id: a7e05eef-3928-4b53-ba21-364c25ee0dda
status: experimental
description: Detects execution of commands commonly used for Active Directory domain account enumeration such as 'net user
  /domain', 'net group /domain', 'dscacheutil -q group', 'ldapsearch', as well as execution of AdFind.exe and ADRecon.ps1
  scripts.
author: Shakedown
date: '2026-10-27'
tags:
- attack.t1087.002
- attack.discovery
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  net_user:
    CommandLine|contains: net user /domain
  net_group:
    CommandLine|contains: net group /domain
  dscacheutil:
    CommandLine|contains: dscacheutil -q group
  ldapsearch:
    CommandLine|contains: ldapsearch
  adfind_image:
    Image|endswith: AdFind.exe
  adrecon_image:
    Image|endswith: ADRecon.ps1
  condition: net_user or net_group or dscacheutil or ldapsearch or adfind_image or adrecon_image
falsepositives:
- Legitimate administrative use of net, ldapsearch, AdFind, or ADRecon by authorized personnel.
level: medium

expert.rule_text:
title: PUA - AdFind.EXE Execution
id: 514e7e3e-b3b4-4a67-af60-be20f139198b
related:
    - id: 455b9d50-15a1-4b99-853f-8d37655a4c1b
      type: similar
status: experimental
description: Detects execution of Adfind.exe utility, which can be used for reconnaissance in an Active Directory environment
references:
    - https://www.joeware.net/freetools/tools/adfind/
    - https://github.com/redcanaryco/atomic-red-team/blob/f339e7da7d05f6057fdfcdd3742bfcf365fee2a9/atomics/T1087.002/T1087.002.md
author: Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel (Nextron Systems)
date: 2025-02-26
tags:
    - attack.discovery
    - attack.t1087.002
logsource:
    product: windows
    category: process_creation
detection:
    selection:
        - Image|endswith: '\AdFind.exe'
        - OriginalFileName: 'AdFind.exe'
        - Hashes|contains:
              - 'IMPHASH=d144de8117df2beceaba2201ad304764'
              - 'IMPHASH=12ce1c0f3f5837ecc18a3782408fa975'
              - 'IMPHASH=bca5675746d13a1f246e2da3c2217492'
              - 'IMPHASH=4fbf3f084fbbb2470b80b2013134df35'
              - 'IMPHASH=49b639b4acbecc49d72a01f357aa4930'
              - 'IMPHASH=53e117a96057eaf19c41380d0e87f1c2'
              - 'IMPHASH=680dad9e300346e05a85023965867201'
              - 'IMPHASH=21aa085d54992511b9f115355e468782'
    condition: selection
falsepositives:
    - Unknown
level: medium
